translations.text: Lord, I confess to you all my sins and misdeeds, everything I ever said wrongly or did wrongly or thought wrongly,
in words and deeds and thoughts, whether I remember it or do not remember it, whether knowingly or unknowingly, under compulsion or not under compulsion, sleeping or waking:
false oaths and lies, covetous desires and wicked deceits, fornications of whatever kind I committed, and wicked sinful lusts in food and in drink and in wrongful sleep;
that you, Lord, grant me salvation and grace, and that I may stand unashamed before your eyes, and that in this world I may have repentance and penance for my sins, as your mercy wills.
All-ruling Lord, almighty God, be pleased to help me and be pleased to grant me salvation and grace in your kingdom.
Almighty God, be pleased to help me and to grant me wisdom and understanding and good will, together with right faith, for your service.
Lord, you came into this world to save sinners; be pleased to keep me and save me.
Christ, Son of God, holy Lord, as you will and as your grace allows, deal with me, your sinful and unworthy servant.
Holy Lord, gracious God, be pleased to help me, your sinful and lost servant, who hopes in your grace.
Gracious and merciful Lord, you alone know what my needs are:
into your grace and into your mercy, holy Lord, I commend my heart and my thoughts and my will and my mind and my body and my words and my deeds.
Show your grace, holy Lord, in me, your sinful and unworthy servant. Be pleased to save me from all evil.
